summary: The selected continuation keeps one sole owning plan and preserves finite pilot acceptance. Delivered CLI/native selection and Observation-only writer source does not establish installed Project 3 acceptance. Paired programme, organization driver, check, recovery, reporting and cross-repository consumer sources are prepared together with explicit supported runtime model/effort routes, original owners/holds and the six reporting user-delta intents. They grant no live switch or organization V1 fallback; existing authorized issue/plan/native-PR work continues while installed, migration, UI and real-use gates remain open. Canonical generator retirement removes only organization V1 projected guidance; product contracts remain isolated. The selected migration source route is typed prepare/apply/readback in the existing packaged board-v2 CLI/shared GitHub adapter under a separate exact migration authorizer, never an expansion of Observation-only authority or a fork of the historical offline importer. Prepare binds a complete predecessor snapshot and semantic delta with unresolved new native IDs; accepted readback supplies actual IDs before final stable enrollment and positive installed inspection/refresh/selection. Preserve existing Status option identities/card values; default writes no existing human planning fields. Native lack of conditional/CAS updates requires scoped owner coordination or an explicit no-write disposition, not a claimed GitHub lock. Supported API view configuration does not establish grouping/sort/column order or visual acceptance. Retain exact original request custody, one-shot effects, readback-only uncertain reconciliation, no automatic retries and zero writes for an unchanged reconciled repeat. This decision authorizes source preparation only; publication, actual installed identity, native mutation admission, UI verification, coordinated adoption and manual-v3-status retirement remain separate gates. The concrete production approval supplier is the accountable owner’s explicit invocation of the reviewed bounded CLI for the exact separately admitted prepared operation. The CLI constructs private typed invocation admission after exact digest/source/principal/scope and fresh preconditions validate; native capability proves permission only. No caller JSON grant, synthetic absent-supplier placeholder, new signing service or V1 permit is introduced. Existing CLI reporting is post-run only: source must add a narrow exclusive private per-invocation pre-send evidence sink rather than claim that custody already exists. Report/custody failure after possible send remains Unknown and stops writes.
title: Prepare coordinated current-only consumers and bounded packaged Project 3 migration
